measurement_note: Size is n, the length of nums; k scales as n/6 while m remains 2. Legal tiers 6, 24, and 96 span 16x and repeat a mixed-sign pattern so extending, closing, and separating subarrays all remain relevant. The accepted incremental-start DP is O(nk). A correct DP that enumerates every legal start for every end is O(kn^2), must return every expected answer, and must fail only scaling.
